full.en: ORGANIC CHOCOLATE GRANOLA with raw cacao, coconut & chia seeds. Sweetened with coconut sugar & agave syrup. May contain traces: PEA- NUTS, NUTS, SOY BEAN, MILK and SESAME. Storage: Store in a cool and dry place. Neto weight 320 g. Best before end: see top of the bag. It is recommended not to exceed the dose of 15 g of chia seeds per day!
